annotations.title: Gross salary needed for a net amount in Greece

description: The gross yearly salary in Greece that leaves a given take-home pay, with the same situation options as net_salary. Use it to set a salary ask or check an offer.

age.description: Age; changes the result here (young-worker reliefs, senior slabs, surcharges). Default 35.

five_c.description: Article 5C relocation incentive. 50% of employment income exempt for 7 years after moving tax residence to Greece. Default false.

period.description: Whether net_target is per year or per month. Default year.

name: gross_for_target_net
